tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" query --use_legacy_sql=false --replace=true \
  --destination_table="${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.scaled7b36f6" \
"WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(f1) AS m1, AVG(f2) AS m2, AVG(f3) AS m3, AVG(f4) AS m4,
    STDDEV_POP(f1) AS s1, STDDEV_POP(f2) AS s2, STDDEV_POP(f3) AS s3, STDDEV_POP(f4) AS s4
  FROM \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}._stg_train\`
),
combined AS (
  SELECT row_id, 'train' AS split, f1, f2, f3, f4 FROM \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}._stg_train\`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT row_id, 'serve' AS split, f1, f2, f3, f4 FROM \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}._stg_serve\`
)
SELECT
  c.row_id,
  c.split,
  ROUND((c.f1 - s.m1)/s.s1, 6) AS f1,
  ROUND((c.f2 - s.m2)/s.s2, 6) AS f2,
  ROUND((c.f3 - s.m3)/s.s3, 6) AS f3,
  ROUND((c.f4 - s.m4)/s.s4, 6) AS f4
FROM combined c CROSS JOIN stats s" 2>&1 | tail -3
tool_input.description: Create standardized feature table in BigQuery

tool_input.content:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(f1) AS m1, AVG(f2) AS m2, AVG(f3) AS m3, AVG(f4) AS m4,
    STDDEV_POP(f1) AS s1, STDDEV_POP(f2) AS s2, STDDEV_POP(f3) AS s3, STDDEV_POP(f4) AS s4
  FROM DSET._stg_train
),
combined AS (
  SELECT row_id, 'train' AS split, f1, f2, f3, f4 FROM DSET._stg_train
  UNION ALL
  SELECT row_id, 'serve' AS split, f1, f2, f3, f4 FROM DSET._stg_serve
)
SELECT
  c.row_id,
  c.split,
  ROUND((c.f1 - s.m1)/s.s1, 6) AS f1,
  ROUND((c.f2 - s.m2)/s.s2, 6) AS f2,
  ROUND((c.f3 - s.m3)/s.s3, 6) AS f3,
  ROUND((c.f4 - s.m4)/s.s4, 6) AS f4
FROM combined c CROSS JOIN stats s

tool_input.command:
SQL=$(sed "s/DSET/${GCP_BQ_DATASET}/g" .tmp/scale.sql)
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" query --use_legacy_sql=false --replace=true \
  --destination_table="${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.scaled7b36f6" "$SQL" 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Run standardization query into destination table

tool_input.command:
printf 'SELECT split, COUNT(*) n FROM %s.scaled7b36f6 GROUP BY split ORDER BY split' "$GCP_BQ_DATASET" > .tmp/v.sql
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" query --use_legacy_sql=false "$(cat .tmp/v.sql)" 2>&1 | tail -6
echo "=== sanity: train means should be ~0 ==="
printf "SELECT ROUND(AVG(f1),6) a1, ROUND(AVG(f2),6) a2, ROUND(AVG(f3),6) a3, ROUND(AVG(f4),6) a4 FROM %s.scaled7b36f6 WHERE split='train'" "$GCP_BQ_DATASET" > .tmp/v2.sql
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" query --use_legacy_sql=false "$(cat .tmp/v2.sql)" 2>&1 | tail -6
tool_input.description: Verify row counts per split and train means near zero
